properties.fixedSizeHint: Text is drawn at the chosen size and may run past the box.
properties.fitShrinkHint: Text keeps its line breaks and shrinks until it fits the box.

Delete {{count}} print job from the history?

cutMode.label: Cutting
cutMode.HalfCutHint: Cuts through the label but not the backing, so the labels stay together and peel easily. The strip is cut off after the last label.
cutMode.CutAtEndHint: No cuts between labels; one cut after the last.
cutMode.ChainPrintingHint: Cuts between labels but keeps the last one in the printer until the next print or the feed button. Saves the blank tape the printer feeds at the start of each job.
cutMode.CutMarksHint: No cutting: all labels print as one strip with a dashed line at each cut, to cut by hand.

printers.title: Printers
printers.name: Name
printers.modelHintNetwork: {{model}} ({{dpi}} dpi) prints directly over the network: add it by IP address or hostname.
printers.modelHintUsb: {{model}} ({{dpi}} dpi) connects by USB: choose it under USB on the computer it's plugged into, or share it from a CUPS server and add that server here as a print server.
printers.modelHintUnknown: Tapeory doesn't know this model; it prints like a PT-P750W (180 dpi, tape up to 24 mm).
printers.printServerNote: For CUPS: in the queue's settings (Administration → Modify Printer), set the connection to "AppSocket/HP JetDirect" with socket://<printer IP or hostname>:9100. Queues found automatically (dnssd://… .local) often can't reach the printer, especially when CUPS runs in a container.
printers.queueNameHint: The printer's name on a CUPS or IPP print server, as in http://server:631/printers/<name>. Leave empty to send to the server's raw port.
printers.usbIdentifierPlaceholder: The printer's device (Linux, e.g. /dev/usb/lp0) or its name in Windows
printers.testPrintSizeHint: Only used by the Test Print button; print jobs use the template’s size. Leave it empty to use the tape the printer reports.
printers.confirmDelete: Delete printer "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
printers.elsewhereNote: Connected to {{name}}. Test and print from Tapeory on that computer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.statsResetConfirmText: Printed labels, tape length and the other print statistics start again from zero. Templates, printers and your print history are kept, and you can undo this.
settings.statsResetError: Couldn’t update the statistics. Please try again.
settings.backupDatabaseText: A complete copy of the database — templates, printers, print history and settings — saved on the server. Images and .lbx files aren’t included; the label backup has those.
settings.backupLabelsText: All label templates with their images and original .lbx files, saved on the server as one archive.
settings.backupRestoreDatabaseConfirmText: Replace the entire database with the backup from {{date}}? All changes made since then will be lost. The current state is backed up first, so you can go back. Accounts are restored too: afterwards, sign in with an account from the backup.
settings.backupRestoreLabelsConfirmText: Replace all current label templates with the ones in the backup from {{date}}? The current templates are backed up first, so you can go back. Print history is kept.
settings.backupError: That didn’t work. Please try again.
settings.usersIntro: Administrators manage printers, backups, statistics and users. Users design and print labels.
settings.usersActionError: That didn't work. Please try again.
settings.usersTemporaryHint: Give it to them: they choose their own password when they first sign in. It isn't shown again.
settings.usersResetConfirm: Give {{name}} a new temporary password? They're signed out everywhere.
settings.usersDeleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}'s account? Their print jobs stay in the history.
settings.usersDeleteTransfer: Transfer them to me (they stay private)

setup.title: Welcome to Tapeory
setup.intro: Tapeory stores your templates, printers and print history in a MySQL or MariaDB database. Enter its connection details to finish setting up.
setup.storedNote: These details are saved in a file on the server, so you only need to enter them once.
setup.testSucceededNewDatabase: Connection successful. The database “{{database}}” doesn’t exist yet and will be created.
setup.desktopIntro: Where should Tapeory keep your templates, printers and print history?
setup.localText: A local database in your user folder. Nothing else to set up.
setup.serverTitle: On a MySQL or MariaDB server
setup.serverText: Share everything with a Tapeory server, for example your Docker installation.

auth.signInIntro: Sign in with your Tapeory account.
auth.rememberMe: Stay signed in on this device
auth.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? An administrator can reset it in Settings → Users.
auth.createIntro: This first account is the administrator: it manages printers, backups and other users. Once it exists, Tapeory asks everyone to sign in.
auth.createNote: Use at least 8 characters. Keep the password somewhere safe: without another administrator, it can only be reset on the server.
auth.forcedIntro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
auth.failedFallback: That didn't work. Please try again.
auth.openBanner: Anyone on your network can use Tapeory. Create an administrator account to require signing in.

desktop.storedNote: These details are saved in a file on this computer, so you only need to enter them once.
